Single continuous first-person shot of Gou An resting on his rope bed exactly as in the supplied frame, same identity, clothing, pose and light. Quiet breathing and natural eyes only. Arms stay resting, no object or other person enters. No player face, body, reflection or over-the-shoulder view. No captions, writing, titles, labels, cards, lists, tables, screen text, blur patches, masks, mosaic or overlays. Real paper props must stay unmarked or seen obliquely out of focus through natural photography; do not add postproduction panels.

SPOKEN DIALOGUE WHITELIST IS EMPTY. No dialogue, no narration, no extra human voice, no muttering or reading. Any visible man listens with lips gently closed. Quiet breathing or a natural blink is allowed, but no sustained speaking mouth shapes. No BGM, no background music, no score, no singing or musical rhythm. Only soft location ambience and action-synchronous natural sound.
